name: Blur-bloom word
description: A word resolves out of a blurred colour glow; the accent colour appears only on this word.

recipe.build: Radial-gradient div filter:blur(60px) scale 1.4 to 1; text filter:blur(14px) to 0 with letter-spacing tightening; accent colour only on this word.

use_when: The question or emotional beat that follows a calm scene.
avoid: Do not bloom more than one word per world; do not use on body copy.
